{{Quote|Groups like the Happy Blasters give this trade a bad name. Almost anyone can tell you about disasters these types of mercenaries have caused, incidents like the Benkal Plagues or the water crisis on Orroman, but not many people can remember the name of the scout who discovered their world or who charted the territory they live in.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref>}}
'''Orroman''' was an astronomical object<ref name="SD" /> that was located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Orroman system/Legends|Orroman system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point, a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] caused a [[Water crisis on Orroman|water crisis]] there, with information about the disaster eventually becoming general knowledge across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] reign, the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Korren Starchaser]] compared in his [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] the mercenary group [[Happy Blasters]] with the group that had caused the [[Water/Legends|water]] crisis, considering them both disreputable.<ref name="SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orroman was first mentioned in the article "[[Scouts' Dispatch]]," which was written by [[Peter Woodworth]] and published in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 13]] in [[May]] [[1997]].<ref name="SD" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Orroman [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Orroman itself, in grid square I-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
